$comment: D4.41 — REDUCING B AND E TO MECHANISMS THE REPOSITORY ALREADY EXECUTES.
Acceptance invariant: a satisfaction implementation may reuse mechanism, but it may not inherit
semantic ownership. Stopping rule: if B or E cannot be expressed by composing existing mechanisms
while preserving the recorded truth-makers, the requirement is not yet reduced enough to implement.
Result: B reduces. E does not, and the stopping rule was applied rather than worked around.
status: B REDUCED — proof module, not wired into generation. E NOT REDUCED — stopping rule applied.

the_only_production_code_change.change: `function matches` → `export function matches`, plus a comment naming the two input shapes it evaluates silently and wrongly. Visibility only; its one caller in that file is unchanged; conceptRecords and conceptVerticalSlice pass unchanged.
the_only_production_code_change.$why_exporting_was_the_only_option: D4.40 forbade a second evaluator and D4.39 named 'duplicating the predicate engine' as unsupported. Reusing the one evaluator that exists required making it reachable.

corrections_found_while_reducing.$recorded_because: Reduction means running the precedents, not reading them. Running them overturned claims three earlier records made from reading.

D4_39_B_had_a_shape_not_an_evaluator.claimed: Case B's precedent — concepts.requires_dimensions — was 'built, shipped and tested'.
D4_39_B_had_a_shape_not_an_evaluator.true: No code anywhere reads requires_dimensions. It is a declared data shape. The D4.39 test checked that the shape existed in JSON; it never checked that anything evaluated it.
D4_39_B_had_a_shape_not_an_evaluator.what_B_actually_reuses: The operations B needs ARE executed, inside resolveConcept: matches() for one predicate, Array.every across a source's `when` list (conjunction), and first-positive-wins across sources (disjunction). The composition is new; each operation is not.
D4_39_B_had_a_shape_not_an_evaluator.$the_invariant: A declaration is not an evaluator.

D4_40_counted_declarations_not_behaviour.claimed: 7 of 10 concepts assume when unresolved — safe_default ×3, present ×3, absent ×1.
D4_40_counted_declarations_not_behaviour.true: 7 DECLARE an assumption; the resolver IMPLEMENTS 4. `safe_default` → PRESENT (3 concepts), `absent` → ABSENT (1). The three `assume: present` declarations fall through unhandled and stay UNRESOLVED.
D4_40_counted_declarations_not_behaviour.does_the_decision_stand: Yes, on live behaviour. Three concepts still convert 'cannot establish' into 'applies' in the running system, which is the construct that inverts dangerously across the applicability/satisfaction boundary. The count was wrong; the asymmetry is real.
D4_40_counted_declarations_not_behaviour.and_it_exposed: A latent concept-layer defect — see concept-layer-gaps.json.

D4_37_SUPPLY_row_was_reasoned_from_a_tem.true: The instrument actually shipped reads '…in relation to Stainless steel commercial kitchen equipment: 1800 mm x 600 mm work tables, four-tier storage racks and 300-litre undercounter refrigeration units, all in 304-grade brushed finish.' The placeholder is filled.
D4_37_SUPPLY_row_was_reasoned_from_a_tem.re_measured_not_hand_edited: The probe now classifies from the RENDERED clause. D4_37_SUPPLY_row_was_reasoned_from_a_tem.$the_near_miss: I expected this row to move to UNRESOLVED and was about to record '4 → 3' by hand. Re-running the instrument showed the verdict survives for a different reason. A hand-edited count would have been a new error.
D4_37_SUPPLY_row_was_reasoned_from_a_tem.$the_invariant: A template is not the artifact — and correcting a reason is not the same as correcting a verdict.

D4_40_G1_is_at_least_two.claimed: One clause (TECH_SOURCE_CODE_001) still awaits the polarity split.
D4_40_G1_is_at_least_two.true: IP_OWNERSHIP_001's rendered text differs materially by world under one id: a client-exclusive assignment when the client owns, 'allocated in accordance with the following arrangement: Shared IP' when shared.
D4_40_G1_is_at_least_two.$proposition_relative: Whether that is a G1 hazard depends on the claim. For 'IP vests in the client' it is false in the Shared world; for 'ownership is specified' it is a legal question. Any implements on that id must hold in every world that renders it.
D4_40_G1_is_at_least_two.$not_a_census: Found incidentally while building case F. How many clauses render materially different substance by world under one id has not been measured.

B_joint_satisfaction.module: backend/services/propositionSatisfaction.js — one import (matches), not wired into generation
B_joint_satisfaction.the_shape: Fixed depth two, no operators, no nesting. Every REQUIRED dimension must be satisfied (AND across); a dimension is satisfied by ANY present clause declaring it (OR within). A dimension may carry one `required_when` condition, evaluated by matches().

who_owns_what.the_proposition: its dimensions and when each is required — the truth condition. It names NO clauses.
who_owns_what.the_clause: which dimension of which proposition it claims to establish — declared where the knowledge is authored (case C).
who_owns_what.the_mechanism: whether one {var, op, value} condition holds in a context. Nothing else.

what_the_layer_owns_that_the_mechanism_m: An ABSENT condition variable is UNRESOLVED. matches() returns false, which would drop the dimension as not required and let the proposition go green on a question nobody answered.
VACUITY — no dimension required — is UNRESOLVED, never ESTABLISHED. The default the other way is D4.37's vacuous satisfaction.
An UNDECLARED clause is not a clause that establishes nothing. A dimension no declaring clause covers is UNSATISFIED only if every present clause has declared; otherwise UNRESOLVED.
A definite failure in a conjunction is a definite failure. That is logic, not an assumption, and it is the only negative the layer concludes.
refused_at_admission: an array `var` — matches() reads it as one comma-joined key and returns false silently
any `op` but `eq` for required_when — matches() returns false for an unknown op, and `present`/`in` are not demonstrated for B
any clause list on a proposition or dimension (satisfied_by, fails_if, clauses…) — the id-list coupling, rebuilt
requires_content — case E is not reduced

the_context_is_the_object_the_gates_saw.fact: The raw IP intake carries no assigns_* at all. The blueprint gates read derived controls: copyright true, patents false, trademarks false.
the_context_is_the_object_the_gates_saw.consequence: required_when is judged against draft.metadata.resolved_generation_controls. Judged against the raw intake, every dimension goes UNRESOLVED — the absent-is-not-false rule makes the wrong object fail SAFE rather than fail wrong.

demonstrated_on_real_drafts.result: all-rights authoring NOT_ESTABLISHED; rights-in-play authoring ESTABLISHED. Same draft, same proposition id, opposite verdicts. The evaluator chose neither legal answer.

demonstrated_on_real_drafts.draft: SOFTWARE_DEVELOPMENT_AGREEMENT, both allocation worlds via the real ip_ownership field
demonstrated_on_real_drafts.result: ESTABLISHED by IP_OWNERSHIP_001 in one world, by IP_DEVELOPER_RETAINS_001 in the other. Existential satisfaction survives the conjunction.
Binding: ESTABLISHED from the LIVE declaration on MOU_BINDING_001. Non-binding: not established — polarity handled by clause identity, no new mechanism.

what_B_cannot_do_until_case_C.finding: With the live library, B can establish a proposition or escalate it, but it can almost never conclude NOT_ESTABLISHED — because a negative requires every present clause to have declared what it establishes, and 3 of 316 have.
what_B_cannot_do_until_case_C.shown: The all-rights authoring on the real IP draft is UNRESOLVED today and NOT_ESTABLISHED only under a HYPOTHETICAL in which every present clause has declared.
what_B_cannot_do_until_case_C.$why_this_is_the_right_failure: No false positive and no false negative — only escalation. It is also the cost of case C, made exact: the authoring obligation is what licenses a negative verdict.

E_context_dependent_satisfaction.verdict: NOT REDUCED — the stopping rule applies
what_running_it_showed: SUPPLY_AGREEMENT's intake has no `purpose` field, yet the rendered clause is filled with a detailed goods description.

`{{purpose}}` is resolved by a fallback chain of FIFTEEN sources in variableInjector: purpose, services_description, consulting_services, business_purpose, jv_purpose, mou_purpose, project_description, product_description, goods_description, property_description, security_collateral — then SYNTHESISED sentences built from company_name, partnership_name, jv_name, loan_amount, guaranteed_amount, property_address.
So rendered presence is guaranteed whenever almost anything is filled, including by boilerplate manufactured from a party name. Presence is not evidence that substance was stated.
The truth-maker is WHICH source filled the placeholder — a user's own description, or a manufactured sentence — and the injector discards that.

the_two_routes_and_why_each_is_refused.route: Condition satisfaction on the source fields — 'any of these description fields is present'.
refused_because: It is a SECOND ENUMERATION of the fallback chain, correct only while every description source precedes every synthesised one. Reorder derivePurpose and the two copies diverge silently — the 'two call sites that currently agree' defect Phase A removed, and D4.38's fifth guardrail.

Worse, it would import the INJECTOR'S DRAFTING HEURISTIC — which fields may fill a placeholder — as a LEGAL TRUTH CONDITION about what states a scope. That is semantic leakage from the rendering path into satisfaction.

the_two_routes_and_why_each_is_refused.route: Have the injector report which source filled each placeholder, and read that.
the_two_routes_and_why_each_is_refused.refused_because: It changes the generation path, which D4.41 may not do.

E_context_dependent_satisfaction.the_unblocking_requirement: PLACEHOLDER-LEVEL CONTENT PROVENANCE: the rendering path records, for each substituted placeholder, which source supplied it.
E_context_dependent_satisfaction.$the_connection: This is D4.34-B's provenance gap one level down. D4.34-B: a third of shipped clauses cannot say which stage put them there. D4.41: a filled placeholder cannot say which field — or which manufactured sentence — filled it. Satisfaction on content needs the second the way auditability needs the first.
E_context_dependent_satisfaction.second_instance_observed: IP_OWNERSHIP_001 in the Shared world: the operative allocation of new IP is the literal form label 'Shared IP' substituted into the clause. Recorded as a question for the advocate; not pursued.

what_was_not_touched: concept unresolved_behaviour — including the three defects in it this phase found
what_this_record_does_not_do: It does not wire the reduction into generation or validation.
It does not add any proposition to the vocabulary or any implements declaration to a clause — the fixtures that exercise B live under tests/.
It does not generalise B past the demonstrated cases: one operator, one condition per dimension, depth two.
It does not decide which authoring of the IP proposition is legally correct.

correction_D4_42.what: Case A/G1 evidence was produced by setting `is_binding_mou` directly on assembleDocument. `is_binding_mou` is the derived control the MOU blueprint gate reads (generationControls.js derives it from the form field `binding_nature`); it is not a form field, and assembleDocument does not sanitise input to the form.
correction_D4_42.consequence: The test injected the gate's input instead of the user's answer, skipping the derivation, and judged an assembled rather than a shipped draft.
correction_D4_42.does_the_conclusion_change: No. Re-run through `binding_nature` and generateDocument: 'Binding' ships MOU_BINDING_001 and is ESTABLISHED from the live declaration; 'Non-binding' ships MOU_NON_BINDING_001 and is not established.
correction_D4_42.what_changed: tests/satisfactionReduction.test.mjs case A/G1 now drives `binding_nature` through generateDocument and asserts that `is_binding_mou` is not a form field.
correction_D4_42.stage_of_case_B_stated: Case B remains on the ASSEMBLED draft because IP_ASSIGNMENT_AGREEMENT ships no draft under the well-filled fixture (0 clauses). What is judged there is clause selection, which assembly completes. This is now stated in the test.
correction_D4_42.adjacent_observation_for_the_advocate: 'Partly binding' derives is_binding_mou = true and ships MOU_BINDING_001: the same clause, byte-identical to 'Binding'. Whether a partly-binding MOU may be drafted as wholly binding is a legal question and is not decided here.
